`final class Lwjgl2Backend`<br/>
**Extends:** [`Backend`](/reference/backends/backend/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.backend.lwjgl2` · **Module:** `backend-lwjgl2` · **Source:** [Lwjgl2Backend.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/backend/lwjgl2/src/main/java/dev/joid/backend/lwjgl2/Lwjgl2Backend.java)<br/>
**Backends:** <span class="joid-badge">LWJGL 2</span>

The backend for LWJGL 2, which draws with OpenGL into the `Display` and plays sound with the OpenAL of LWJGL 2.

## Description

Call [`Lwjgl2Natives.install`](/reference/lwjgl2/lwjgl2natives/#Lwjgl2Natives-method-install) before the `Display` exists, register the backend once it exists, and call [`Lwjgl2InputForwarder.poll`](/reference/base-lwjgl2/lwjgl2inputforwarder/#Lwjgl2InputForwarder-method-poll) at the start of every frame: LWJGL 2 pushes no input events.
